column1: # The safety floor's deny-list by function (ADR 0026, point 5), written by hand. The remediation plan
# never makes an item of these apps, at any level. Columns: package, or a prefix followed by *; vendor
# (* for every phone, otherwise the maker as Android names it, in lower case); function (core,
# telephony, emergency, updates, setup, time-zone, connectivity, device-lock); source; checked.
# A source shows what the package does, or a public report of what broke without it. Community debloat
